story.fullStory:
The Tee Set's "Ma Belle Amie" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Ma Belle Amie" is a song by Tee-Set, released as a single from the album Ma Belle Amie.

1 in South Africa, and reached the Top 10 across central Europe.

The original song, whose French title means "My Beautiful Friend", features a French lyric line: "Apres Tous les beaux jours je te dit merci merci" ("After all the beautiful days, I say thank you, thank you").

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.
